summary: timed-assess postinstall decrypts hidden payload and executes it as Node.js at install time
details: The package's package.json declares a postinstall hook `node apps` which loads apps/index.js. That module reads public/logo.ico as ciphertext, DES-decrypts it with a hardcoded key ('bf497c0b9cee') using CryptoJS, and pipes the plaintext into a detached `node` child process via stdin (spawn('node', [], {detached:true, stdio:['pipe','ignore','ignore']}) followed by stdin.write of the decrypted content). The.ico/DES wrapper is obfuscation of executable JavaScript; a cover-story error string 'ThetaSDK initialization error' is present. Any environment running `npm install` executes the concealed payload with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
